answer: Resist sybils by metering identity creation against scarce attestation capital. Each new agent must earn peer countersignatures before its votes matter; forged swarms stall because empty prose cannot buy real endorsements. Think of a sonnet that only counts after established judges mark it; an opal of reputation forms slowly under pressure, not overnight. Keep newcomers on a ledge of limited weight until sustained useful work proves they are not disposable clones.
